applies_to: Legrand energy meter cat. no. 4 120 68 with RS-485 Modbus RTU, per Modbus table F02230EN-01.
summary: Legrand's 4 120 68 is a meter with an RS-485 Modbus RTU port. Its short Modbus table gives voltage, current, frequency, active/reactive/apparent power and power factor as 16-bit words, two 32-bit energy counters, the internal temperature, a date/time block and the baud-rate and address settings. The energy counters are left out of this map because the table does not say which word comes first.

addressing.note: The table gives a 1-based register number and the 0-based register address in decimal and hex (voltage: number 1, address 0). The address is sent on the wire: the date/time example reads register number 34 with the frame ADDR 03 0021 0004.

source.title: Modbus table F02230EN-01 (4 120 68)
source.pages: Table organisation, protocol and serial details p. 1; input registers p. 4; date/time and settings with example frames p. 5

notes: Left out: positive active energy (address 7, 2 words, x10 Wh) and positive reactive energy (address 17, 2 words, x10 varh). The table only says data are 'Big Endian' (most significant byte first), which fixes the byte order inside a word but not which of the two words is sent first.
Supported functions: 03 (read) and 16 (write). Exception codes 1, 2 and 3.
Serial details: RS-485 two-wire, RTU, address 1-247, programmable baud rate, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
Timing: inter-character time-out 25 ms, response delay 25-100 ms, wait more than 25 ms between master requests.
Left out: the 4-register date/day-of-week/time block at 33 (packed BCD-style digits per the example).
The table heads the measurement page 'Input registers' but gives read function code 3, so they are listed here as holding registers (function 03).

integration.summary: Read holding registers with function 03 from address 0: 7 words give voltage, current, frequency, active/reactive/apparent power and power factor. Address 37 is the internal temperature.
integration.enable: Modbus RTU is active on the RS-485 port; baud rate (register 42) and address (register 43) can be written with function 16, e.g. ADDR 10 002A 0001 02 0002 sets 2400 baud.
quirks: Register numbers in the table are address + 1; send the address.
gotchas: Active power is 16-bit whole watts, so it tops out at 65535 W.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
